shared_elements: horizontal band filled with repeated short vertical strokes (comb/fringe motif)
repeated row of similar animal forms
justification: Both surfaces stack motifs into loose horizontal registers and both feature a long horizontal element edged with a dense row of short vertical strokes (the fringed band on A, the crewed hulls on B), alongside profile quadrupeds and small human figures. But the manner is wholly different: A is three-dimensional carved relief on a shaped pillar with solid, modelled bodies, while B is flat red-outlined linear drawing spread over an irregular rock face with no framing or ordered sequence.
